# A-Life Singularity x Clean-Slate v3.0 Omega Package (v3.5.0)

> Zero-consolidation scientific engineering stack unifying Clean-Slate v3.0 micro-hardware runtime invariants (11-pool FP64 conservation, Philox4x32-10, XPBD, 10x10x10 Hybrid Cube, Hardware Ring-0 ACL) with macro A-Life Singularity metrology (OVBS-52, 78-alert ALifeOps YAML, 748-run paired falsification, 360 Pure 6-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 theorems [310 native + 50 local], AMS-LaTeX white paper, and a 1,900-problem Mega-Atlas non-retirement audit).

## Core Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, 5-second Lean 4.35.0 verification, quickstart, honest boundary, file directory
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims ledger (`C1–C8`) with epistemic tiers and explicit falsification conditions
- [EVIDENCE.md](EVIDENCE.md): Primary verification artifact map per claim
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Threats to validity and Literal-vs-Metaphor boundary table
- [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md): Six-layer verification architecture (`22/22` Forensic Gates + `90`-item Build Standard)
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone step-by-step replication protocol and replication log
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): 3-cycle adversarial hardening log classified under the 10 finding classes
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): Complete folder/file/byte/token master index across the entire repository
